task: Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/tone44.wav already loaded (a 2-second mono 44.1 kHz WAV). Change the project rate to 22050 Hz (which will resample the audio). Export the result to /home/user/Music/tone22.wav as a mono 22050 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV file.
task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/tone44.wav already loaded (a 2-second mono 44.1 kHz WAV).

Resample the audio down to 22050 Hz:
1. Change the 'Project Rate (Hz)' control in the bottom-left corner of the Audacity window to 22050.
2. Use Tracks > Resample... and enter 22050 in the dialog, then click OK.

Once the track and project sample rate are both 22050 Hz, export as WAV to /home/user/Music/tone22.wav using File > Export > Export as WAV. Keep the default 'WAV (Microsoft) signed 16-bit PCM' format; Audacity will automatically export at the current project rate of 22050 Hz.
